site.description: Portfolio of an SSC CGL aspirant and AI web developer building real projects while preparing to become an officer.

hero.intro: Two years of SSC preparation, two CGL attempts, and one belief: discipline in study and discipline in code come from the same place. I am writing my way from techie to officer.

about.heading: Two desks, one goal
paragraphs: I am an SSC aspirant who has been preparing for the last two years. I have appeared in CGL twice and have not cleared it yet, but every attempt has made my preparation sharper and my resolve stronger.
Alongside the books, I work as an AI web developer. I build full websites and apps with AI as my pair programmer, taking them from idea to a live link that anyone can open.
Studying for an exam and shipping code both reward the same habits: showing up daily, fixing what is broken, and not quitting after a bad result.
This site is my public notebook. It tracks how much syllabus is done, how many days are left, and what I am building next.
One day the title on this page will change from aspirant to officer. Until then, I keep learning and keep shipping.
